title: Dallas Avionics conducts radio training for Fairfax County Virginia
summary: The training was designed to help all area law enforcement units maximize the use of their leading-edge Technisonic radios.
body_markdown:
Dallas Avionics recently conducted training for Fairfax County Area Law Enforcement agencies in Fairfax County, Virginia, on Technisonic radios.


The training, hosted by the Fairfax County Police Department, was designed to help all area law enforcement units maximize the use of their leading-edge Technisonic radios.


“Fairfax County Police Department and the surrounding regions play a vital role in the safety and protection of Northern Virginia, and the Washington, D.C. region,” said Dallas Avionics government agency sales executive Cody Klaehn, a retired Texas DPS Aircraft tactical flight officer training lieutenant.


“Because of staffing constraints, it is more difficult for some law enforcement agencies to have their personnel leave their duty stations to attend training seminars. That is why we are taking the training to them.”


Dallas Avionics has been known for its offering of high-end avionics, law enforcement and communications equipment for more than 50 years.


But the service does not stop after the sale of equipment. Dallas Avionics not only trains on the radios but also other mission critical components found within the aircraft. The company plans to conduct more regional training based on the needs of air operations around the United States.


“We first want to thank Fairfax County for hosting the training. And we want to thank them for all they do to keep the area safe and secure. We appreciate Captain Karen Maslona for hosting this initial training. We look forward to partnering with additional air units to conduct tailored training to further enhance mission safety. We hope with our training efforts, we will help units know how to maximize the use of their new equipment to its fullest potential,” said Klaehn.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Dallas Avionics.*
